Les_Paul wrote:

fxyogi wrote: Hi Pedini et al,

I wonder what could be the difference between this FTR concept and trend direction change by checking conventional HH,LL.

I am still finding what is the logic behind this FTR concept.

Is there any source i can study this concept?.

I agree to a certain extent: often, there in no difference between FTR and conventional HH/LL concept. But sometimes (often enough...) FTR simply cannot be discovered and utilised by conventional concept. See the chart.

کنجکاوم تفاوت این مفهوم FTR با تغییر جهت روند از طریق بررسی HH و LL متداول چه می‌تواند باشد.
